description: This is a Java unit test class for the WhoamiResponse class, testing its creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and immutability.

classes.name: WhoamiResponseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of WhoamiResponse, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and immutability.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Tests the static factory method WhoamiResponse.of() to create a response and verifies headers and entity.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson() method returns the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests the fromJson() method to create a WhoamiResponse instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Verifies that setEntity() correctly updates the entity and that the entity's JSON matches expected.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Validates the equals() and hashCode() methods implement consistency as verified by EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Checks the immutability of WhoamiResponse instances using MutabilityDetector.
